title: tests/userspace/Makefile: build all userspace test binaries
description: Makefile for tests/userspace/ that compiles test_chardev, test_concurrent, and test_af_alg as standalone C binaries. Links against pthread for concurrent tests. Includes ../../../include/uapi/wolfkm_ioctl.h. Supports CFLAGS override. Also installs test scripts (test_dm_crypt.sh, test_luks.sh, test_ipsec.sh) as executable.
design: Standard GNU Makefile. CC variable. test_chardev and test_concurrent compile from their respective .c files. test_af_alg uses AF_ALG sockets (no external deps). Shell test scripts just need chmod +x. Clean target removes binaries.
acceptance_criteria: make in tests/userspace/ produces three binaries and three executable shell scripts with zero warnings.
